deals.title: Walmart Black Friday movie deals (4K included)
deals.detail: Walmart's Black Friday movies, music and books event runs through Nov. 29, per Dealnews. 4K standout: Columbia Classics Collection Volume 5 4K set $96 ($32 off).

deals.title: Arrow Video Black Friday sale: up to 50% off 4K and Blu-ray
deals.detail: Arrow's US store advertises up to 50% off hundreds of 4K UHDs and Blu-rays plus a free gift on orders of $70 or more. AndersonVision's Black Friday 2026 guide counts about 394 sale titles and an extra 10% off baskets over $90; Arrow's own post says the offer ends Monday (Nov. 30).

deals.title: Gruv Black Friday 4K film collections (new customers)
deals.detail: Gruv's Black Friday collection offer for new customers with code FIRSTGRUV15, valid through Nov. 30 or while supplies last, per Slickdeals: Fast & Furious 10-Movie Collection 4K $44.19, Superman 5-Film Collection 4K $42.50, The Lord of the Rings Extended Editions 4K $42.50, The Hobbit Trilogy 4K $34, Back to the Future: The Ultimate Trilogy 4K $25.50.

deals.title: Back to the Future: The Ultimate Trilogy
deals.detail: $25.50 & More, 4K Film Collections

deals.title: Vinegar Syndrome Black Friday sale (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: Started today at 12:01 a.m. ET and runs through Dec. 1 at 11:59 p.m. ET, per the label's official FAQ: 50 to 70% off the list price of all VS, sub-label and partner-label titles released before May 2026, which covers its back catalog of 4K UHD restorations. Titles released from May 2026 on aren't discounted. The FAQ doesn't list per-disc prices.

deals.title: Barnes & Noble 50% off Criterion Collection sale (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: Half-off Criterion sale on 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD through Dec. 6, per Popular Science. 4K picks it names: The Princess Bride, No Country for Old Men and Blue Velvet $24.99 each; Seven Samurai 4K $29.99; Wes Anderson Archive 4K set $249.99. Dealnews adds that most single 4K titles land at $25, including Harold and Maude and The Right Stuff.

deals.title: Criterion Collection 50% off at Amazon (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: 50% off Criterion 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD through Dec. 7, per Consequence. 4K picks include The Silence of the Lambs, The Princess Bride and No Country for Old Men; the Complete Stanley Kubrick 4K Collection is $299.98.

deals.title: KPop Demon Hunters (Criterion 4K UHD)
deals.detail: 4K UHD for $24.98 (list $49.95), part of the Criterion 50% off sale, per HD Report.

deals.title: MVD Annual Black Friday & Cyber Week Sale
deals.detail: 3,500+ titles on sale through Dec. 7, prices from 99 cents; AndersonVision's guide notes Eureka titles are part of it. 4K example on MVD's sale page: Maniac (4K UHD + Blu-ray) $24.99, down from $49.95.

deals.title: Radiance Films Black Friday sale
deals.detail: Radiance's sale runs until Dec. 9; AndersonVision's Black Friday 2026 guide lists the US offer through Dec. 9 with a $75 minimum. Check each title for a 4K edition; I couldn't see specific 4K prices.
